cbeattie.1770: Casimir Cbeattie introduced himself as a railway porter from Ashford Vale. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.

Casimir Cbeattie studied the trench map until the candle died, then walked S-F19 in the dark to learn it by heart. A letter from home reached Casimir Cbeattie before dusk. Casimir Cbeattie read it twice and slept a little easier.

A shell burst over S-F19 and threw Casimir Cbeattie into the side of the trench. Cuts, bruises, ringing ears. He stayed at his post. A letter from home reached Casimir Cbeattie before dusk. Casimir Cbeattie read it twice and slept a little easier.
j.t.772: Bastian Jt came from Greyhallow, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
Bastian Jt of the Hegemony spotted Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar of the Concord repairing a parapet at Hill 304. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot.
raptor2561: Gustav "Mud" Raptor came up on Day 3 carrying news from Halden. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired. Orders assigned Gustav "Mud" Raptor to work as a machine gunner. The first lesson began with what not to touch.
Gustav "Mud" Raptor caught a falling mug with his boot. Nobody could say if it was skill or luck, and he did not say either.
Dawn watch. Gustav "Mud" Raptor put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Dietrich Linningorchi, grazed.

A flare caught Gustav "Mud" Raptor halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached. A letter from home reached Gustav "Mud" Raptor before dusk. Gustav "Mud" Raptor read it twice and slept a little easier.
tomishidk: Quentin Tomishidk came up with a draft of replacements on Day 3. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

A pump handle snapped off in Quentin Tomishidk's hands. He fixed it while the water rose around his ankles. The transfer made Quentin Tomishidk a stretcher bearer. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.
A football came over the parapet from the Hegemony side with Dorian Coletonmarti's name scratched on it. Quentin Tomishidk kicked it back. It did not come again.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Quentin Tomishidk tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at S-F18 is up.
